scope: The follow-ups from the 1.0.0.9 test: the menu button forwarded as one clean press, with the other controls kept through a short loss of focus (both clients); Game Mode's SteamVR started without gamescope's display marker and given the headset display under a plain name, a compositor that cannot take it stopping Start at once, and the last Game Mode start kept for reports (Bazzite); a bitrate step taken for uneven arrival undone when it did not help (both clients); three tries for a base station, with the signal of one not reached. Every package carries version 1.0.0.10; the host's driver is 1.0.0.9's, unchanged.
changes: client/device/input_protocol.hpp (SystemButtonLatch, SystemButtonEvents, holdThroughFocusLoss), openvr_device.cpp/.hpp: SteamVR's ButtonPress/ButtonUnpress events for the system button read as well; a press forwarded for at least 0.12 s and once; other controls kept through a focus loss under 0.5 s; SYSTEM_BUTTON lines, focus and button-event counters on INPUT (both clients)

client/platform/linux/lease.cpp: the display socket named vrostbridge-headset-<pid> in the runtime directory, LEASE_CLIENT lines for each program that connects and binds the lease interface, LEASE_READY with the name
launcher/game_mode.py: LEASE_READY's name checked (owner, mode, path); GameModeStartLog (game-mode-last-start.json)

launcher/client_runtime.py: SteamVR started without GAMESCOPE_WAYLAND_DISPLAY when given the headset display; the display SteamVR's server was started with read from its environment and logged; the compositor's lines about the headset display logged; Start stopped at once on error 496 with the reason
launcher/app.py: the Game Mode start log fed and ended per Start; game_mode_last_start in every client report

launcher/stream_budget.py: a step down for uneven arrival alone checked against the median packet-interval spread before it and undone when frames arrive no more evenly; source-limited seconds no longer count as uneven arrival
launcher/base_stations.py and BaseStations.ps1: three tries 2 s apart, a fresh search before each retry on Bazzite, the signal strength of a station not reached
tests: tests/test_vrostbridge_1010.py, new contract tests in tests/input_tests.cpp; earlier release tests made to accept later releases (version, base-station tries)
Version 1.0.0.10 on every package; documents, release notes and the two PDFs

host.driver: 1.0.0.9's, byte for byte: ALVR f5023f8e with patches 0001 to 0023 (no patch changed)

toolchain: As 1.0.0.9: Ubuntu 24.04.5, GCC 13.3.0, CMake 3.28.3 + Ninja 1.11.1 (Linux client); clang-cl/lld-link/llvm-lib/llvm-rc 19.1.1 + xwin Windows SDK and CRT (Windows client and launchers); PyInstaller 6.22.3 / Python 3.12.3; NSIS 3.09; ReportLab (PDFs) with mermaid-cli in Chromium; Wine 9.0 with Mesa lavapipe; Node 22 (page checks); PowerShell 7.4.6 (script parse). The driver, both transports and FFmpeg's DLLs are 1.0.0.9's builds, not rebuilt: their sources are unchanged since 1.0.0.9.

documents_review: A separate review of the 1.0.0.10 documents against the code found seventeen points to correct before packaging, three of them in the code as well: the SYSTEM_BUTTON line's focus=taken meant that the button went unread, not that focus was taken, so the line now reports both (focus=lost, unread=1) and INPUT counts both per hand; the base stations' signal strength was read from BlueZ after the search had ended, when BlueZ no longer has it, and is now taken from bluetoothctl's lines during the search; and the governor's notes put seconds with too few frames down to the rendering PC alone. In the documents: SteamVR keeps gamescope's X display, so only gamescope's Wayland marker is gone; the search before a retry and the signal strength are Bazzite's only; the other controls are kept through a short press only; LEASE_CLIENT shows who reached the adapter and LEASE_GRANTED the lease; the adapter's new socket code is tested as source; the early stop at error 496 applies in Desktop Mode too. All were corrected; the packages checked here carry the corrected documents and code.
